column1: # 马里奥赛车 8 豪华版（Switch，基础版 1.0.0 与更新 4.0.1）的游戏档案。
# Game profile of Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (Switch, base game 1.0.0 and update 4.0.1).
# 状态 | Status: 打包就绪，起机未做 | packaging-ready, bring-up not done.
# 着色器：29,651 个，13,060 个 metallib 编译成功，14 个失败（0.047%，全是翻译器
# 生成 `unknown` 返回类型）。对照：马力欧 331/9,043 对失败（3.7%）。
# Shaders: 29,651 found, 13,060 metallib built, 14 failed (0.047%, all of them
# the translator emitting an `unknown` return type).  For comparison, Mario
# failed 331 of 9,043 pairs (3.7%).
# 起机还完全没做：SDK 是 4_4_0（马力欧 16_2_0），NVN 对象尺寸、API 版本、服务
# 布局都要按 docs/agents/03 逐项核对；nn::audio 有 140 个导入符号（占导入面
# 15.5%），nn::mii 91 个，nn::fontll 23 个，nn::nfp 11 个（amiibo）；main 还
# 叠了 nn::gfx / nw::g3d / nw::vfx / nw::atk / nw::ui2d 五层中间件。
# Bring-up has not been attempted: the SDK is 4_4_0 (Mario is 16_2_0), so NVN
# object sizes, API version and service layouts all need checking against
# docs/agents/03; nn::audio imports 140 symbols (15.5% of the import surface),
# nn::mii 91, nn::fontll 23, nn::nfp 11 (amiibo); main also layers nn::gfx /
# nw::g3d / nw::vfx / nw::atk / nw::ui2d on top.
# 下面每个值都来自本作自己的 NSP：模块、RomFS 标记与内存分区由粗查实测，着色器表
# 由 shader_split.py 扫描生成。
# Every value below comes from this title's own NSPs: the modules, RomFS marker
# and memory partition were measured by the survey, and the shader tables were
# generated by scanning with shader_split.py.
# 格式：键 <TAB> 值 | Format: key <TAB> value
# ---- 身份 | Identity ----
title_id
program_id
name
ipa
app_category
# ---- 版本 | Versions ----
# 基础版 1.0.0 与更新 4.0.1 的 main 构建号相同，两个版本共用同一套改写与着色器表。
# sdk / subsdk0 / rtld 在基础版与更新之间字节相同，只有 main 不同。
# The base 1.0.0 and update 4.0.1 share main's build ID, so one set of rewrites
# and shader tables serves both.  sdk / subsdk0 / rtld are byte-identical
# between the base game and the update; only main differs.
build
build
package
shader_versions
# ---- 模块 | Modules ----
# 除 main / sdk 外还有 subsdk0（NintendoSDK_NVN），装载顺序 main、subsdk*、sdk。
# Besides main / sdk there is subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_NVN); load order main, subsdk*, sdk.
modules
romfs_marker
zip_store
# ---- 内存分区 | Memory partition ----
# 应用池取 Switch 4 GB 机型的 3285 MiB，与其它档案一致；nninitStartup 请求
# 0xc1c00000（池减去模块占用），实测 SetHeapSize 在该容量下成功。
# The application pool is the 3285 MiB of a 4 GB Switch, as in every other
# profile; nninitStartup asks for 0xc1c00000 (the pool minus the module
# footprint) and SetHeapSize succeeds at that capacity (measured).
mem_reserve
mem_alias
mem_stack
app_pool
# ---- 着色器分组 | Shader groups ----
# RomFS 前缀到着色器组的映射，与 shader_split.py 的容器识别对应：
# Common/Gfx 下的 *.sharcb 与 agl/gsys 的 .sarc 是 agl（BAHS sharcb），
# Common/Mii 的 .bfsha 是 BNSH，Common/Effect 是特效。
# RomFS prefix to shader group, matching shader_split.py's container detection:
# the *.sharcb and the agl/gsys .sarc under Common/Gfx are agl (BAHS sharcb),
# Common/Mii's .bfsha is BNSH, Common/Effect holds the effects.
shader_groups
shader_note

column1: # SDK 是 4_4_0，不是马力欧的 16_2_0：NVN 对象尺寸、API 版本与服务布局都要按
# SDK 4 逐项核对（docs/agents/03）。
# The SDK is 4_4_0, not Mario's 16_2_0: NVN object sizes, API version and
# service layouts all need checking against SDK 4 (docs/agents/03).
# ---- NVN 绑定布局 | NVN binding layout ----
# 纹理 / 采样器 / 图像句柄在 c[2] 驱动表里的偏移，dmsh_build.py 用它把着色器名字里的
# Ryujinx TextureHandle 反推成槽号。此处取 D2R / Engage / Metroid Dread 相同的布局
# （0x168 + 8×slot，128 槽；采样器 0x568；图像 0x120），因为 MK8DX 的着色器来自
# nn::gfx 中间件而非马里欧的 agl 路径，需要按 04-graphics 的方法实测确认。
# 若翻译出现「绑定没解出槽号」的着色器，改这里后重编。
# Offsets of the texture / sampler / image handle tables in c[2], used by
# dmsh_build.py to turn the Ryujinx TextureHandle in a shader's name back into a
# slot.  These are D2R's / Engage's / Metroid Dread's layout (0x168 + 8*slot, 128
# slots; sampler 0x568; image 0x120): MK8DX's shaders come from the nn::gfx
# middleware rather than Mario's agl path, so they need confirming by the method
# in 04-graphics.  If the build reports shaders with unresolved slots, change
# these and rebuild.
nvn_tex_base
nvn_tex_slots
nvn_samp_base
nvn_img_base
nvn_img_slots
nvn_ssbo_bases
